 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Confidental"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "Confidential" which means intended to be kept secret. (गोपनीय)

 
 
• **Example: **The document contains confidential information that must not be shared.
 
 
 
• **"Confidential" **refers to something that is meant to be kept secret or private. (गोपनीय)
 
 
• **Example: **The company's financial records are confidential and not available to the public.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Measurement **(मापन): The act or process of measuring something.

 
 
• **Example:** Accurate measurement is crucial in scientific experiments.
 
 
 
• **Region **(क्षेत्र): A specific area or part of the world, country, etc.
 
 
• **Example: **The Amazon rainforest is a vast and diverse region.
 
 
 
• **Strengths** (ताकतें): This is the incorrect spelling; the correct spelling is "Strengths" which means qualities or abilities that someone or something has that gives it an advantage. (ताकतें)
 
 
• **Example:** One of her strengths is her ability to stay calm under pressure.
